Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Elena Rostova
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: The service and staff at the Grand Hyatt were absolutely phenomenal! The front desk concierge handled our check-in seamlessly, and the room comfort was top-tier. Breakfast spread was vast and delicious.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Marcus Vance
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Extremely clean room and comfortable king-sized bed. The location is very central, though traffic noise outside during peak morning hours was slightly noticeable.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Sarah Jenkins
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Disappointed with the room service delay. We waited over an hour for dining orders, and the food arrived lukewarm. The staff apologized, but for a luxury rate, this shouldn't happen.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: David Miller
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Incredible spa experience and brilliant concierge team. The room cleanliness was spotless, and the evening rooftop dining offered stunning city views.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Priya Sharma
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: The pool and fitness amenities were great, but the Wi-Fi speed was sluggish in the business center, which was frustrating for my remote meetings.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Oliver Bennett
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Outstanding executive lounge options! Evening complimentary drinks and hors d'oeuvres were high quality, and staff went out of their way to make us comfortable.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Claire Sterling
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Housekeeping completely missed our room on the second day. When called, it took them two hours to send fresh towels. Terrible service standards.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Rahul Nair
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Great business travel hotel. The conference rooms were well-equipped and the airport shuttle was right on schedule.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Emma Watson
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Loved the indoor heated pool and fitness center. Housekeeping left cute towel swans and handwritten notes every morning!

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: George Rossi
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Valet parking cost an exorbitant amount per night and took 25 minutes to retrieve my vehicle during morning checkout.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Anette Lindqvist
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: As a World of Hyatt Diamond member, I was upgraded to a corner suite with stunning harbor views. The Digital Key check-in on the mobile app worked without a single hitch.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Carlos Ruiz
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: The lobby scent and flower arrangements create a very welcoming atmosphere upon arrival. Front desk staff were polite, though check-out queue was long.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Tariq Mansoor
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: The bathroom fixtures felt slightly dated, and water pressure in the shower fluctuated between hot and cold during peak hours.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Helena Fischer
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Wonderful pre-arrival communication! The guest relations manager emailed us ahead of time to confirm our anniversary requests and left champagne in the room.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Benjamin Hayes
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Billing mistake upon check-out. I was charged for breakfast items that were included in my package rate, and service recovery took over a week of emails.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Samantha Cole
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: The bed bedding and blackout curtains provided the best night of sleep I've had in months. Highly recommend the executive club level.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Vikram Patel
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Solid F&B options on-site. The sushi bar in the lobby lounge was surprisingly fresh and fast, perfect for a late late-night bite.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Laura Martinez
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Air conditioning unit in the room was extremely noisy throughout the night, making it difficult to sleep peacefully.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Derek Thorne
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Exceptional doorman and valet service. From the moment our taxi pulled up, our luggage was handled with utmost care.

Grand Hyatt Regency.author: Nils Gunnar
Grand Hyatt Regency.text: Nice property, but turn-down service was hit-or-miss. They only came on two out of four nights during our stay.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Sophia Chen
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Flawless hospitality from start to finish! The room and comfort exceeded expectations. Staff members knew us by name and made our wedding anniversary unforgettable.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Liam O'Connor
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The dining & breakfast experience here is second to none. Exceptional pastries, freshly brewed coffee, and attentive waiters.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Rachel Adams
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Beautiful property and great location, but street construction noise woke us up early at 6:00 AM. Earplugs were provided, but soundproofing could be better.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Michael Thorne
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Unacceptable wait times at the front desk check-in. Only one staff member was managing a queue of fifteen guests. Not worth the premium cost.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Chloe Dubois
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Exceptional bar and cocktail lounge! The valet service was prompt and professional, though the room temperature was tricky to adjust initially.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Siddharth Verma
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The afternoon tea service at the Plaza lobby is world-class. Impeccable sandwich selections and rich tea varieties.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Isabelle Laurent
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Luxurious marble bathroom with high-end toiletries. Only minor complaint was that the room service menu lacked vegan options.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Daniel Kowalski
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The hot tub was closed for unexpected maintenance throughout our weekend stay, which was one of the main reasons we booked.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Aisha Al-Mansoor
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Top-tier concierge service. They managed to secure last-minute reservations at a Michelin-star restaurant for my family.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Brian Gallagher
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Classic luxury aesthetic, but the furniture in our suite showed visible wear and scuffs on the wood frames.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Evelyn Reed
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club level is worth every penny. Personal club concierge team took care of all our daily tour bookings effortlessly.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Hiroshi Tanaka
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Impeccable housekeeping. The room was refreshed twice daily, and the pillow menu ensured maximum sleep comfort.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Gavin MacLeod
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The hotel gym was cramped and lacked sufficient free weights. For a five-star hotel, the fitness center needs serious renovation.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Monica Bellucci
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Stunning floral displays in the entrance gallery. The doorman greeted us with genuine warmth every single morning.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Jonathan Swift
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Extremely rude reception staff during check-out when I pointed out duplicate minibar charges. Poor service recovery.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Karen O'Reilly
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: The pool lounge chairs were comfortable and pool staff immediately brought out fresh towels, ice water, and sunblock.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Fabio Cannavaro
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: In-room dining trolley was elegantly laid out, and the food temperature was perfect upon delivery.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Zoe Kravitz
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Central location for luxury shopping, but taxi retrieval during peak hours took over 20 minutes outside the main entrance.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Antoine Dupont
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: High-speed Wi-Fi worked flawlessly across all areas of the hotel, including the outdoor terrace.

Ritz-Carlton Plaza.author: Sienna Miller
Ritz-Carlton Plaza.text: Beautiful suite layout with high ceilings and velvet furnishings. Deep soaking tub was a major highlight.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Alexander Wright
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Signature butler service was outstanding! Room amenities, bedding, and bathroom cleanliness were immaculately maintained.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Jessica Taylor
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Prime location right in the city center. Easy walking distance to luxury shopping and dining. Room was spacious and quiet.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Carlos Mendez
The St. Regis Downtown.text: The air conditioning in our room was noisy and malfunctioned twice during our stay. Maintenance resolved it eventually, but it disrupted our sleep.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Hannah Schmidt
The St. Regis Downtown.text: World-class dining experience at the main restaurant. The concierge booked us last-minute theater tickets without any hassle. Pure luxury!

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Kenji Sato
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Overcharged on our final checkout bill for minibar items we never consumed. Resolving it with customer support took over three days.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Victoria Sterling
The St. Regis Downtown.text: The evening champagne sabering ritual in the main lobby was such a fantastic tradition. Exceptional attention to detail throughout.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Noah Martinez
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Very quiet and soundproof rooms despite being in the heart of downtown. Bed mattress was extremely supportive and comfortable.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Fatima Hassan
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Breakfast buffet selection was very limited compared to other St. Regis locations I have visited globally.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Lucas Fischer
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Unbelievable service! My butler pressed two suits free of charge upon arrival and unpacked my luggage seamlessly.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Emily Crawford
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Beautiful interior aesthetics, but the elevators were constantly busy and had long wait times during morning check-out hours.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Julian Vance
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Pre-arrival email communication was spot on. My dietary preferences were noted and reflected in every meal I ordered.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Charlotte Webb
The St. Regis Downtown.text: The spa treatment room was tranquil and massage therapists were elite professionals. Highly relaxing afternoon.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Giacomo Puccini
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Key card digital reader stopped working three separate times, forcing me to walk down to reception repeatedly.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Yasmine Al-Fassi
The St. Regis Downtown.text: St. Regis Bloody Mary cocktail at the lounge bar was sublime! Great atmosphere with live jazz in the evening.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Oliver Queen
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Valet parking service was decent, but $75 per night feels steep even for a downtown luxury establishment.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Naomi Watts
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Flawless check-in process. Reception staff offered us welcome drinks and walked us personally to our suite.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Sebastian Bach
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Housekeeping left used room service dishes in the hallway outside our door for nearly 12 hours.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Frederik Lind
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Comfortable work desk and international plug adapters in the room made working remotely very convenient.

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Chloe Zhao
The St. Regis Downtown.text: The turn-down service included lavender pillow mist and gourmet chocolates. Wonderful personalized touch!

The St. Regis Downtown.author: Arthur Pendelton
The St. Regis Downtown.text: Good gym hardware, but the space lacked fresh towels during peak morning workout hours.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Amara Okafor
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: An absolute oasis! The infinity pool views and outdoor spa treatments were unmatched. Staff was incredibly polite and attentive.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Dmitri Ivanov
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Overpriced for what it offers. The room decor felt outdated, and key card readers in the elevators repeatedly failed.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Grace Montgomery
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: The oceanfront villa was spectacular. Private plunge pool was clean, and room service arrived within 20 minutes every time.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Tyler Brooks
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Superb family-friendly resort. Kids club kept our children entertained all day, allowing us to relax at the adult-only pool.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Nadia Patel
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Massage therapists at the spa are true professionals. Left feeling completely rejuvenated. Worth every single penny.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Sean Reynolds
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Horrible experience with food poisoning from the poolside grill. Spent half our vacation sick in the bathroom.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Yuki Tanaka
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Stunning landscaped gardens and private beach access. The staff provided complimentary ice water and sunblock at the beach chairs.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Megan Sullivan
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: The grounds are gorgeous, but service at the beach bar was painfully slow. Waited nearly 40 minutes for two cocktails.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Arthur Pendelton
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Great golf course facilities on-site. Pro shop staff were knowledgeable and gear rentals were in pristine condition.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Zoe Kravitz
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Extremely romantic setting for a honeymoon. Private candlelight beach dinner organized by the team was the highlight of our trip.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Lars Ulrich
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: The breakfast buffet overlooking the ocean was breath-taking. Wide selection of fresh tropical fruits, pastries, and custom egg stations.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Penelope Cruz
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Check-in took over 45 minutes because our villa was not ready at the official check-in time of 3:00 PM.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Xavier Hernandez
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Staff remembered our children's names and brought complimentary toys and kid-sized bathrobes to the room.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Brigitte Bardot
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Spacious bathroom with double vanity and outdoor rainfall shower. Cleanliness was maintained to perfection.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Klaus Meine
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: The noise from ongoing beach club expansion construction ruined our daytime relaxation by the main pool.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Ingrid Bergman
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Yoga classes on the beach at sunrise were amazing. The wellness facilities here are top notch.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Benoit Blanc
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Gorgeous property, but food and drink prices at the main restaurant feel inflated even for Four Seasons standards.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Astrid Lindgren
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Fast shuttle service around the resort grounds via golf carts whenever we requested transport.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Ken Follett
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: The bed and pillow comfort was outstanding. Slept like a log every night of our stay.

Four Seasons Resort & Spa.author: Giselle Bundchen
Four Seasons Resort & Spa.text: Service recovery was remarkable. When our initial room had a minor AC drain leak, we were instantly moved to a higher-tier ocean suite with complimentary champagne.
